parameters.animation_interval: The required120 seconds in each mode are active rotating time. Control/pause probes do not replace that interval; retain distinct animated frame identities across it without imposing an FPS floor.
parameters.GPU_vertices: Vertex shading on the GPU; no CPU vertex path at M1

parameters.connection_policy: Repeat the qualified local X display argument; no remote X connections. Record the actual arguments, display/window/context identities and direct-context evidence for each connection.
parameters.time_origin: First confirmed application frame on every required connection.
checks: visible rotating triangle on every connection
actual client SGX submissions and context/state isolation
completion, retirement and Present release for every connection
resize/expose/close without corruption or unexplained retained growth
refuse: renderer string without matching client GPU evidence
parameters.performance: Report timing separately; this application check is not API conformance.
